record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came again unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
Now, thou son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, take up<WH05375><WTH8798> a lamentation<WH07015> for Tyrus<WH06865>;

And say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto Tyrus<WH06865>, O thou that art situate<WH03427><WTH8802> at the entry<WH03997> of the sea<WH03220>, <FI>which art<Fi> a merchant<WH07402><WTH8802> of the people<WH05971> for many<WH07227> isles<WH0339>, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; O Tyrus<WH06865>, thou hast said<WH0559><WTH8804>, I <FI>am<Fi> of perfect<WH03632> beauty<WH03308>. <RF>of perfect...: Heb. perfect of beauty<Rf>
Thy borders<WH01366> <FI>are<Fi> in the midst<WH03820> of the seas<WH03220>, thy builders<WH01129><WTH8802> have perfected<WH03634><WTH8804> thy beauty<WH03308>. <RF>midst: Heb. heart<Rf>

They have made<WH01129><WTH8804> all thy <FI>ship<Fi> boards<WH03871> of fir trees<WH01265> of Senir<WH08149>: they have taken<WH03947><WTH8804> cedars<WH0730> from Lebanon<WH03844> to make<WH06213><WTH8800> masts<WH08650> for thee. <RF>made: Heb. built<Rf>

<FI> Of<Fi> the oaks<WH0437> of Bashan<WH01316> have they made<WH06213><WTH8804> thine oars<WH04880>; the company<WH01323> of the Ashurites<WH0839> have made<WH06213><WTH8804> thy benches<WH07175> <FI>of<Fi>  ivory<WH08127>, <FI>brought<Fi> out of the isles<WH0339> of Chittim<WH03794>. <RF>the company...: or, they have made thy hatches of ivory well trodden<Rf> <RF>company: Heb. daughter<Rf>

Fine linen<WH08336> with broidered work<WH07553> from Egypt<WH04714> was that which thou spreadest forth<WH04666> to be thy sail<WH05251>; blue<WH08504> and purple<WH0713> from the isles<WH0339> of Elishah<WH0473> was that which covered<WH04374> thee. <RF>blue...: or, purple and scarlet<Rf>

The inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of Zidon<WH06721> and Arvad<WH0719> were thy mariners<WH07751><WTH8801>: thy wise<WH02450> <FI>men<Fi> , O Tyrus<WH06865>, <FI>that<Fi> were in thee, were thy pilots<WH02259>.

The ancients<WH02205> of Gebal<WH01380> and the wise<WH02450> <FI>men<Fi> thereof were in thee thy calkers<WH0919><WH02388><WTH8688>: all the ships<WH0591> of the sea<WH03220> with their mariners<WH04419> were in thee to occupy<WH06148><WTH8800> thy merchandise<WH04627>. <RF>calkers: or, stoppers of chinks: Heb. strengtheners, etc<Rf>

They of Persia<WH06539> and of Lud<WH03865> and of Phut<WH06316> were in thine army<WH02428>, thy men<WH0582> of war<WH04421>: they hanged<WH08518><WTH8765> the shield<WH04043> and helmet<WH03553> in thee; they set forth<WH05414><WTH8804> thy comeliness<WH01926>.

The men<WH01121> of Arvad<WH0719> with thine army<WH02428> <FI>were<Fi> upon thy walls<WH02346> round about<WH05439>, and the Gammadims<WH01575> were in thy towers<WH04026>: they hanged<WH08518><WTH8765> their shields<WH07982> upon thy walls<WH02346> round about<WH05439>; they have made<WH03634><WH00> thy beauty<WH03308> perfect<WH03634><WTH8804>.

Tarshish<WH08659> <FI>was<Fi> thy merchant<WH05503><WTH8802> by reason of the multitude<WH07230> of all <FI>kind of<Fi> riches<WH01952>; with silver<WH03701>, iron<WH01270>, tin<WH0913>, and lead<WH05777>, they traded<WH05414><WTH8804> in thy fairs<WH05801>.

Javan<WH03120>, Tubal<WH08422>, and Meshech<WH04902>, they <FI>were<Fi> thy merchants<WH07402><WTH8802>: they traded<WH05414><WTH8804> the persons<WH05315> of men<WH0120> and vessels<WH03627> of brass<WH05178> in thy market<WH04627>. <RF>market: or, merchandise<Rf>
They of the house<WH01004> of Togarmah<WH08425> traded<WH05414><WTH8804> in thy fairs<WH05801> with horses<WH05483> and horsemen<WH06571> and mules<WH06505>.

The men<WH01121> of Dedan<WH01719> <FI>were<Fi> thy merchants<WH07402><WTH8802>; many<WH07227> isles<WH0339> <FI>were<Fi> the merchandise<WH05506> of thine hand<WH03027>: they brought<WH07725><WTH8689> thee <FI>for<Fi> a present<WH0814> horns<WH07161> of ivory<WH08127> and ebony<WH01894>.

Syria<WH0758> <FI>was<Fi> thy merchant<WH05503><WTH8802> by reason of the multitude<WH07230> of the wares of thy making<WH04639>: they occupied<WH05414><WTH8804> in thy fairs<WH05801> with emeralds<WH05306>, purple<WH0713>, and broidered work<WH07553>, and fine linen<WH0948>, and coral<WH07215>, and agate<WH03539>. <RF>the wares...: Heb. thy works<Rf> <RF>agate: or, chrysoprase<Rf>

Judah<WH03063>, and the land<WH0776> of Israel<WH03478>, they <FI>were<Fi> thy merchants<WH07402><WTH8802>: they traded<WH05414><WTH8804> in thy market<WH04627> wheat<WH02406> of Minnith<WH04511>, and Pannag<WH06436>, and honey<WH01706>, and oil<WH08081>, and balm<WH06875>. <RF>balm: or, rosin<Rf>

Damascus<WH01834> <FI>was<Fi> thy merchant<WH05503><WTH8802> in the multitude<WH07230> of the wares of thy making<WH04639>, for the multitude<WH07230> of all riches<WH01952>; in the wine<WH03196> of Helbon<WH02463>, and white<WH06713> wool<WH06785>.

Dan<WH02051><WTH8676><WH01835> also and Javan<WH03120> going to and fro<WH0235><WTH8794> occupied<WH05414><WTH8804> in thy fairs<WH05801>: bright<WH06219> iron<WH01270>, cassia<WH06916>, and calamus<WH07070>, were in thy market<WH04627>. <RF>going...: or, Meuzal<Rf>
Dedan<WH01719> <FI>was<Fi> thy merchant<WH07402><WTH8802> in precious<WH02667> clothes<WH0899> for chariots<WH07396>. <RF>precious...: Heb. clothes of freedom<Rf>

Arabia<WH06152>, and all the princes<WH05387> of Kedar<WH06938>, they occupied<WH05503><WH00> with thee<WH03027> in lambs<WH03733>, and rams<WH0352>, and goats<WH06260>: in these <FI>were they<Fi> thy merchants<WH05503><WTH8802>. <RF>they occupied...: Heb. they were the merchants of thy hand<Rf>

The merchants<WH07402><WTH8802> of Sheba<WH07614> and Raamah<WH07484>, they <FI>were<Fi> thy merchants<WH07402><WTH8802>: they occupied<WH05414><WTH8804> in thy fairs<WH05801> with chief<WH07218> of all spices<WH01314>, and with all precious<WH03368> stones<WH068>, and gold<WH02091>.
Haran<WH02771>, and Canneh<WH03656>, and Eden<WH05729>, the merchants<WH07402><WTH8802> of Sheba<WH07614>, Asshur<WH0804>, <FI>and<Fi> Chilmad<WH03638>, <FI>were<Fi> thy merchants<WH07402><WTH8802>.

These <FI>were<Fi> thy merchants<WH07402><WTH8802> in all sorts<WH04360> <FI>of things<Fi> , in blue<WH08504> clothes<WH01545>, and broidered work<WH07553>, and in chests<WH01595> of rich apparel<WH01264>, bound<WH02280><WTH8803> with cords<WH02256>, and made of cedar<WH0729>, among thy merchandise<WH04819>. <RF>all...: or, excellent things<Rf> <RF>clothes: Heb. foldings<Rf>

The ships<WH0591> of Tarshish<WH08659> did sing<WH07788><WTH8802> of thee in thy market<WH04627>: and thou wast replenished<WH04390><WTH8735>, and made very<WH03966> glorious<WH03513><WTH8799> in the midst<WH03820> of the seas<WH03220>.<CM>

Thy rowers<WH07751><WTH8801> have brought<WH0935><WTH8689> thee into great<WH07227> waters<WH04325>: the east<WH06921> wind<WH07307> hath broken<WH07665><WTH8804> thee in the midst<WH03820> of the seas<WH03220>. <RF>midst: Heb. heart<Rf>

Thy riches<WH01952>, and thy fairs<WH05801>, thy merchandise<WH04627>, thy mariners<WH04419>, and thy pilots<WH02259>, thy calkers<WH0919><WH02388><WTH8688>, and the occupiers<WH06148><WTH8802> of thy merchandise<WH04627>, and all thy men<WH0582> of war<WH04421>, that <FI>are<Fi> in thee, and in all thy company<WH06951> which <FI>is<Fi> in the midst<WH08432> of thee, shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> into the midst<WH03820> of the seas<WH03220> in the day<WH03117> of thy ruin<WH04658>. <RF>and in...: or, even with all<Rf> <RF>midst of the seas: Heb. heart, etc<Rf>
The suburbs<WH04054> shall shake<WH07493><WTH8799> at the sound<WH06963> of the cry<WH02201> of thy pilots<WH02259>. <RF>suburbs: or, waves<Rf>

And all that handle<WH08610><WTH8802> the oar<WH04880>, the mariners<WH04419>, <FI>and<Fi> all the pilots<WH02259> of the sea<WH03220>, shall come down<WH03381><WTH8804> from their ships<WH0591>, they shall stand<WH05975><WTH8799> upon the land<WH0776>;

And shall cause their voice<WH06963> to be heard<WH08085><WTH8689> against thee, and shall cry<WH02199><WTH8799> bitterly<WH04751>, and shall cast up<WH05927><WTH8686> dust<WH06083> upon their heads<WH07218>, they shall wallow<WH06428><WTH8691> themselves in the ashes<WH0665>:

And they shall make themselves utterly<WH07144> bald<WH07139><WTH8689> for thee, and gird<WH02296><WTH8804> them with sackcloth<WH08242>, and they shall weep<WH01058><WTH8804> for thee with bitterness<WH04751> of heart<WH05315> <FI>and<Fi> bitter<WH04751> wailing<WH04553>.

And in their wailing<WH05204> they shall take up<WH05375><WTH8804> a lamentation<WH07015> for thee, and lament<WH06969><WTH8790> over thee, <FI>saying<Fi> , What <FI>city is<Fi> like Tyrus<WH06865>, like the destroyed<WH01822> in the midst<WH08432> of the sea<WH03220>?

When thy wares<WH05801> went forth<WH03318><WTH8800> out of the seas<WH03220>, thou filledst<WH07646><WTH8689> many<WH07227> people<WH05971>; thou didst enrich<WH06238><WTH8689> the kings<WH04428> of the earth<WH0776> with the multitude<WH07230> of thy riches<WH01952> and of thy merchandise<WH04627>.

In the time<WH06256> <FI>when<Fi> thou shalt be broken<WH07665><WTH8737> by the seas<WH03220> in the depths<WH04615> of the waters<WH04325> thy merchandise<WH04627> and all thy company<WH06951> in the midst<WH08432> of thee shall fall<WH05307><WTH8804>.

All the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of the isles<WH0339> shall be astonished<WH08074><WTH8804> at thee, and their kings<WH04428> shall be sore<WH08178> afraid<WH08175><WTH8804>, they shall be troubled<WH07481><WTH8804> in <FI>their<Fi> countenance<WH06440>.

The merchants<WH05503><WTH8802> among the people<WH05971> shall hiss<WH08319><WTH8804> at thee; thou shalt be a terror<WH01091>, and never <FI>shalt be<Fi> any more<WH05704><WH05769>. <RF>a terror: Heb. terrors<Rf> <RF>never...: Heb. shalt not be for ever<Rf><CM>
